# Refactor Step Prompt

## Task
Refactor a specific item type in the Gilded Rose Kata using the Strategy Pattern.

## Input
Item name (e.g., "Aged Brie", "Backstage passes", "Sulfuras")

## Instructions
- Generate a class for the given item type.
- Implement update logic following Gilded Rose rules.
- Ensure code is clean and easy to extend.
- Do not change existing behavior.

## Output
Provide Python code for the item updater class.
